mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is a clear 81 degrees at Fireman's Park. Tonight, the moon is in its third quarter phase. If you are an early bird, the space station will be visible starting at 4:19 AM, rising near Verona High School and traveling toward Fitchburg. Tonight's low will be 72 degrees, and there is no rain expected.

The City of Verona has officially installed a new public art piece called Tai Chi Animal Frolics in Century School Park. This seven-foot sculpture, created by local artists Gene Delcourt and Christian Felland, was carved from a reclaimed ash tree and honors traditional Tai Chi movements.

You have plenty of local options to enjoy today. You can visit the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park, catch live music at Paddy Mac's, or participate in trivia at The Bogey Factory. Tomorrow, you can also join the fun with trivia at Hop Haus Brewing.

On August 28, the Verona Police Department responded to an incident on South Nine Mound Road where a vehicle collided with a parked car. The driver was cited for inattentive driving, and thankfully, no injuries were reported.
Today at Culver's, the flavor of the day is OREO REESE'S Cheesecake. The restaurant is currently open and will remain so until 10 PM tonight, giving you plenty of time to stop by for a scoop.
